verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a pricing-page line saying users can grant others view-only access to notes, which is in-app sharing. Nothing shows public web publishing of a selected note set as a navigable site with working inter-note links. Missing for 10: public website or digital-garden publishing, evidence that links stay navigable in shared or published notes, selection of note sets to publish, a custom domain or site browsing, and first-party docs or hands-on corroboration.
